Name: XenoTroid
Overview:
Classic arcade asteroid shooter. Control a spaceship as you struggle to stay alive, collect power cells to power up your engines and shoot off to your next adventure.

This game takes the classic elements of the Asteriods style game. Destroying meteors and Slorm will get you more points.

Use your left analog stick to move and your right to fire, also there's health and ammo and a tutorial.
